# Fabula Spark

> Fabula Spark (Arabic: فيبولا سبارك or فبولا سبارك) is an educational brand that brings live science shows to schools. Experiments are told as stories, with fire, vapor, color and big reactions, for a whole school assembly.

## Facts
- Service available to book: live science shows, performed at your school or venue.
- Co-founder: Mahmoud Abdelhafiz (محمود عبدالحفيظ).
- Booking: WhatsApp +20 101 863 7476 (https://wa.me/201018637476) or the inquiry form on the website.
- Other Spark experiences are announced as coming soon and are not bookable yet.
- Pricing and dates are confirmed per school on request. No prices are published.
